requirements.description: The revision MUST be exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
The adapter MUST keep retrieved content inert pending separate approval and verification.
The adapter MUST expose locator semantics only and MUST NOT add authority or compatibility claims.
The adapter MUST NOT replace the exact commit with a branch, tag, default branch, or moving reference.
Browse, archive, and raw URLs MUST retain the declared owner and repository.
